set.body:
Create the lowest portable contracts needed by both image and surface viewers. Generalize or relocate display window/range, threshold visibility, color-scale, invalid-value, opacity, and blend-mode semantics from image-view into a renderer-neutral graphics/display package while preserving source compatibility through aliases or forwarding constructors. Add an opaque topology or mesh-domain identity for surface geometry, derived deterministically from hemisphere, vertex order, and face topology; make SurfaceSet and cross-geometry field use reject equal-sized but topologically incompatible meshes.

Likely paths: modules/graphics/shared, modules/image-view/shared, modules/surface/shared, build.sbt only if a new dependency-free display module is justified.

Acceptance: threshold lower/equal/inside/equal-upper/NaN behavior is exact and shared by image and surface code; topology identity is stable on JVM and Scala.js, distinguishes reordered or changed faces, and permits validated pial/white/inflated correspondence; no graphics-to-domain dependency or module cycle; existing image-view APIs remain source-compatible where practical; graphicsJVM/JS, imageViewJVM/JS, and surfaceJVM/JS tests pass.
set.title: Surface view foundation: shared display encoding and mesh-domain identity
